channel.title: Ionic Framework incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Ionic Framework's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Issues with Bitbucket tokens in Appflow [resolved]
item.description: Tokens were not refreshing as expected, causing builds to fail to initialize. Engineering pushed a fix for this process.

item.title: Issues authenticating with Azure DevOps in Appflow [postmortem]
item.description: On January 6th, 2026, at 1:53 PM EST, Appflow's Azure DevOps integration stopped working. Customers using Azure DevOps as their git provider were unable to authenticate, link repositories, or run builds. The issue was caused by the expiration of our Azure DevOps OAuth client secret, which had been valid for 5 years since its creation in January 2021. The incident was reported on January 7th, 2026, at 12:27 PM EST, and initially resolved at 3:27 PM EST by rotating the secret and redeploying the authentication service. However, on January 8th, 2026, at 11:04 AM EST, we discovered that builds were still failing because a second service \(appflow-apps\) also had a copy of the expired secret. Full resolution was confirmed at 12:51 PM EST after updating the secret in both locations.

item.title: Ionic services temporarily inaccessible due to Cloudflare outage [resolved]
item.description: As a result of Cloudflare's outage, users may have been intermittently unable to access Ionic's services as of 11:48 UTC. The incident was resolved as of 14:57 UTC.
